name: West Falls
source:
Hello, Haunters. 

Dare to venture on another thrilling excursion into the afterlife?

Sage, Cole, and Toma are three college students with an unusual hobby: hunting ghosts for their (poorly trafficked) video channel. However, nobody knows what really lurks in those abandoned places. What happens when the boys bite off more than they can chew?

[From [url=https://greensolid.itch.io/west-falls-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你好，幽灵们。

敢不敢再次踏上惊心动魄的来世之旅？

塞奇、科尔和托马是三名大学生，他们有一个不寻常的爱好：为他们的（流量很少的）视频频道寻找鬼魂。然而，没有人知道那些废弃的地方到底潜藏着什么。当男孩们贪多嚼不烂时会发生什么？

[来自[url=https://greensolid.itch.io/west-falls-demo]itch.io[/url]]
